observations.title: Pruned skills library for frontend scope
observations.content: What: Audited .agents/skills (agentic-awesome-skills) against docs/contexto and SDD; kept HTML/Tailwind/a11y/responsive/SDD skills. Why: reduce noise for agent. Where: .agents/skills/. Learned: cloned repo was a nested git repo; converted to regular files so GitHub shows content.

observations.title: Reverted React/FastAPI stack to single index.html SPA (ADR-003)
observations.content: What: Deleted frontend/ (React+Vite) and backend/ (FastAPI+SQLModel), built index.html with HTML5 + Tailwind CDN + vanilla JS. Why: Clase 07 Requirement 1 demands a single-file SPA; user confirmed deletion. Where: index.html, docs/contexto/arquitectura.md, decisiones.md, .agents/rules/antigravity_global_rules.md.

observations.title: Implemented dark mode and 4 UI states
observations.content: What: Tailwind darkMode class persisted in localStorage, .force-text-white on red surfaces; catalog shows Loading/Empty/Error(?error)/Success; form validation with green success notice; modals close via button/X/backdrop/Esc. Where: index.html, REPORTE_VERIFICACION_SDD.md (ADR-004).

observations.title: Fixed blank screen from removed lucide-react icons
observations.content: What: Facebook/Instagram/Twitter/Youtube icons no longer exist in lucide-react, crashing React render. Fix: replaced with generic icons. Learned: superseded by ADR-003 (React removed), kept as gotcha.

observations.title: Session summary: Clase 07 integrator deliverables
observations.content: Goal: deliver Clase 07 project. Accomplished: index.html SPA, 6 context docs linked in GEMINI.md, REPORTE_VERIFICACION_SDD.md, pushed to github.com/agustin-itec/curso-antigravity. Discoveries: local server must run outside agent sandbox; git remote add does not create the GitHub repo. Next: tick DoD checklist, enable GitHub Pages, record 2-3 min demo video.
